## Declarations and implementations

```plato

// How a track behaves when sampled outside its keyed range: clamp to the
// boundary key's value (Hold), repeat the keyed range (Loop), alternate
// forward and reversed repeats (PingPong), extrapolate along the boundary
// slope (LinearContinue), or repeat while offsetting each cycle by the
// range's net value change (LoopWithOffset).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Extrapolation)
type Extrapolation = Hold | Loop | PingPong | LinearContinue | LoopWithOffset;

// A single typed key on a time line. Time is the offset from the start of the
// owning track. Easing shapes the parameter on the segment from this key to the
// next; it applies when Interpolation is not tangent-based.
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Key_frame)
type Keyframe<T>
{
    Time: Duration;
    Value: T;
    Interpolation: KeyInterpolation;
    Easing: ClassicEasing;
}

// A key with explicit incoming and outgoing tangents for Bezier and Hermite
// interpolation. Tangents are value slopes per second; the weights give each
// handle's reach as a fraction of the segment span (classic default one third).
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cubic_Hermite_spline)
type TangentKeyframe<T>
{
    Time: Duration;
    Value: T;
    InTangent: T;
    OutTangent: T;
    InWeight: Proportion;
    OutWeight: Proportion;
}

// A sequence of keys over one value, with extrapolation policies before the
// first key and after the last. Keys are ordered by ascending Time.
type AnimationTrack<T>
    implements ITimeVarying<T>
{
    Keys: Array<Keyframe<T>>;
    Before: Extrapolation;
    After: Extrapolation;
}

// A track of tangent keyframes, for curves authored with explicit handles.
// Keys are ordered by ascending Time.
type TangentTrack<T>
    implements ITimeVarying<T>
{
    Keys: Array<TangentKeyframe<T>>;
    Before: Extrapolation;
    After: Extrapolation;
}

// A track bound to a target name: a property path, channel name, or bone name,
// depending on the consumer.
type NamedTrack<T>
{
    Name: String;
    Track: AnimationTrack<T>;
}

// Per-channel animation of a 2D transform: translation, rotation, and scale
// each keyed independently.
type TransformTrack2D
{
    Translation: AnimationTrack<Vector2D>;
    Rotation: AnimationTrack<Angle>;
    Scale: AnimationTrack<Number2>;
}

// Per-channel animation of a 3D transform: translation, rotation, and scale
// each keyed independently. Rotation keys interpolate by spherical
// interpolation (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Spherical_linear_interpolation).
type TransformTrack3D
{
    Translation: AnimationTrack<Vector3D>;
    Rotation: AnimationTrack<Quaternion>;
    Scale: AnimationTrack<Number3>;
}
```
